policies.title: Rotation policies
policies.intro: Which accounts the chats of a project may use, in which order, and at what usage to move on to the next. A project with no policy follows the global rotation settings.
policies.noneHint: Every project follows the global rotation settings.
policies.projectsHint: A project has at most one policy.
policies.thresholdHint: A chat stays on its account until the account's binding window crosses this.
policies.orderHint: Add accounts to limit the policy to them, and order them. A chat takes the first one with room.
policies.addAccount: Add an account to the order
policies.saveFailed: The policy could not be saved
policies.deleteBody: Its projects go back to the global rotation settings. Chats already running stay on their accounts.
policies.looseChatsHint: Also govern the chats started in a directory that is under no imported project. Without this, they follow the global rotation settings.
policies.looseChatsTaken: Another policy already governs the chats without a project: at most one may.

history.title: Usage history
history.intro: How much of each rate-limit window an account used, from the readings Claude reports while it runs and the CLI's cache while an account is idle.
history.noneHint: Readings arrive as runs report them. A range from before the first run has none.
history.chartTitle: Share of the rate-limit window used, over time
history.describeSeries: {{account}}: {{latest}}% now, at most {{peak}}% in the range.
history.table: Show the figures as a table
history.tableCaption: Usage readings per account in the chosen window and range

page.title: Accounts
page.noneHint: Claude Code runs on its own config directory until you add accounts. Add one to switch to it at a limit.

card.noLimitsApiKey: An API key has no usage limits to read.

remove.title: Remove {{name}}?
remove.body: Claudio forgets the account and deletes its config directory. Chats already started on it keep their transcripts.

dialog.title: Add an account

hint.login: Signs in with Claude Code in a config directory of its own. Claudio never reads the credentials.
hint.token: A token from claude setup-token. It has no identity of its own, so it needs an alias.
hint.api-key: An API key. It has no identity and no usage limits to read, so it needs an alias.

dialog.aliasOptional: Optional: shown instead of the email.
dialog.aliasRequired: Required: shown wherever the account is named.
dialog.emailHint: Optional: pre-fills the email the sign-in asks for.
dialog.secretHint: Write-only: it is kept in a private file of the account and never shown again.
dialog.addFailed: The account could not be added

signIn.title: Sign in to the account
signIn.open: Open this page and sign in
signIn.approve: Approve the access for Claude Code
signIn.codeHint: Only if the page shows a code because the browser could not open on its own.
signIn.starting: Asking Claude Code for the sign-in page…
signIn.failed: The sign-in failed. Close this dialog and try again.

rotation.title: Switching accounts
rotation.subtitle: What work does when an account reaches its limit.
rotation.rotateHint: Off: a chat waits for its account to reset instead of moving to another.
rotation.thresholdAt: counts as at its limit from {{pct}}% of 5 h or 7 days
rotation.hysteresisHint: Points below the threshold an account must fall before it is chosen again.
rotation.cooldownHint: How long an account that hit a limit is left alone when its reset is unknown.
rotation.updateFailed: The settings could not be saved

log.title: Switches and waits
log.hint: A chat that moves to another account, or waits for a reset, appears here.

modelFallbacks.title: Model fallbacks
modelFallbacks.intro: When no account with room can run a chat's model, the chat waits. A fallback lets it continue on another model you accepted here; nothing changes model on its own.
modelFallbacks.noneHint: Chats wait for an account that can run their model.
modelFallbacks.noSuggestion: No suggestion for {{model}}. The decision point may be off, or no other account offers a model close to it.
modelFallbacks.suggestFailed: Could not ask for a suggestion
